text:
Sam K: Heads-up: Orion goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. I drafted a short customer-facing quick-playbook for caching, batching, streaming fallbacks, and renewal signals. Please skim and add anything actionable.

Nina L: Nice. Keep the customer copy short. Call out an explicit "what we need from you" list: traffic estimate, critical prompts, expected p50 latency goal.

Sam K: Agreed. Draft customer blurb: 
- Quick prep: share expected qps and top-10 prompts.
- Priming: we recommend a priming pool ≈ 2x baseline qps for 30m pre-go-live.
- Batch rules: prefer 8-12 msgs/batch for multi-turn chat; if you need <150ms median, use 2-4 msgs/batch.
- Streaming: use streaming for interactive UIs; client should handle a 2s idle gap then switch to non-stream mode.
- UX fallback copy (client): "We're switching to a faster delivery mode due to intermittent stream issues. Responses will continue as normal."

Ravi V: Add a tiny JSON config example customers can paste into their console: 
```json
{"priming_pool":40,"batch_target":10,"stream_idle_timeout_ms":2000,"fallback_policy":"small_model_after_3_latency_failures","telemetry_enabled":true}
```

Jules M: On renewal-risk signals for CS: flag accounts for an Enablement touch if any of these in 7d: weekly tokens < 8k, >3 distinct config errors, or p95 latency > 1s for 2 separate days.

Nina L: Also recommend an immediate concierge session if customer flags >2 failed prompts in the eval set. Provide them a 10-prompt smoke test to run post-deploy.

Sam K: Telemetry to expose to customers and CS: p50/p95 latency, batch_size_avg, stream_conn_fail_rate, priming_pool_utilization, sample_feedback_rate.

Ravi V: Feedback capture recommendation: 1% random sample + deterministic sampling on new prompt templates. UI should offer quick tags: Good / Wrong intent / Hallucination + optional comment.

Jules M: Internal SRE ops checklist (T-minus, T+0..72h): 
- T-30m: scale priming pool; confirm readiness qps >= expected.
- T+0..+15m: watch batch_size_avg, stream_conn_fail_rate every 60s.
- If p95 increases >25%: reduce batch_target by ~25% and trigger capacity add.
- If stream_conn_fail_rate spikes: instruct clients to fallback to polling and use exponential backoff (250ms base, max 4s).

Sam K: Also add rollback/fallback routing: if median latency >600ms for 3 consecutive minutes, automatically route new requests to smaller quantized model for best-effort responses.

Nina L: For customer enablement handoff: CS + SE assigned for first 72h with 10min daily stand to triage. After 72h hand to AM. Create a support template for the concierge tuning session.

Ravi V: Client-side snippet for graceful retry (JS example): 
```js
// simple backoff
let backoff = 250;
function retryPoll() {
  setTimeout(() => { /* poll logic */ }, backoff);
  backoff = Math.min(backoff * 2, 4000);
}
```

Jules M: Sampling and escalation: if feedback flags show >2% hallucination rate over 1k sampled requests, auto-create a ticket for model ops review.

Sam K: I'll turn this into a customer one-pager and a CS playbook. If no objections, we ship the support template and activate sampling at 1% on day 0. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Orion go-live final prep" 08:15 PT tomorrow.

OPS Pager: I'll cover oncall T+0..+36. Ping me for immediate capacity ops.

Sam K: Thanks all. Dropping the one-pager link in AM. If anyone wants to tweak the customer copy, add here and I'll fold it in.
